criteria.requirement: A parser that takes raw formatted military text (USMTF format), extracts frequency plans, crypto change-over windows, and flight quarters event times, and plots them on a consolidated visual timeline.
criteria.detail: Extract all three named categories directly from fictional pipe-delimited OPTASK text, review the mock type mapping and source evidence, and display overlapping intervals on a consolidated UTC timeline. Synthetic only; not validated against actual USMTF formats or operational rules. — demonstrated by daily-schedule, exclude-non-event, answer-key at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Every extracted field has exact source offsets.
criteria.detail: Every source-derived field has a zero-based end-exclusive UTF-16 span into its immutable revision; the sample frequency start evidence is 2026-11-04T06:00:00Z. Derived values retain original-field links. — demonstrated by daily-schedule at both viewport sizes.

Empty source is rejected; missing timezone, impossible calendar date and unsupported line produce distinct issues with zero invented events; explicit correction creates revision 2 and preserves revision 1. Draft changes block review and export. — demonstrated by invalid-recovery, exclude-non-event, stale-review at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Normalize time zones without shifting the event.
criteria.detail: 01:00 at -05:00 normalizes to 06:00Z; a 23:30–00:30 flight interval remains 60 minutes and displays 30 minutes on each UTC day. — demonstrated by utc-boundary, daily-schedule at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: Review output against an independent answer key.
criteria.detail: Packet method is human. No independent person has performed or recorded inspection of the held-out synthetic key and actual application output. A generated score or model statement cannot stand in for that person’s review. The answer-key journey still demonstrates the complete synthetic comparison under UC12-1; MSG-04 remains unverified.

After opening the self-contained local file, parsing, review, timeline and both downloads require no network. Reload restores source and reviewed state when local storage is available. — demonstrated by daily-schedule at both viewport sizes.

criteria.requirement: A tool that seamlessly converts mock USMTF raw text into a synchronized 24-hour visual schedule for watchstanders and shipboard leaders.
criteria.detail: Convert the fictional raw message to the Synchronized 24-hour Visual Schedule with Frequency Plan, Crypto Change-over Window and Flight Quarters, a common 00:00–24:00 axis, accessible day list and reviewed CSV/traceability JSON exports. — demonstrated by daily-schedule, utc-boundary at both viewport sizes.
